verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנֵּה֙ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי בְקֹֽלְכֶ֔ם לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לִ֑י וָאַמְלִ֥יךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl hin·nêh šā·ma‘·tî ḇə·qō·lə·ḵem lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ă·mar·tem lî wā·’am·lîḵ ‘ă·lê·ḵem me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to all Israel . . . I have listened to your voice in all that you have said to me and I have set over you a king
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO disse Samuel a todo o Israel: Eis que ouvi a vossa voz em tudo quanto me dissestes, e constituí sobre vós um rei.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ׀ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֗ם וַאֲנִי֙ זָקַ֣נְתִּי וָשַׂ֔בְתִּי וּבָנַ֖י הִנָּ֣ם אִתְּכֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם מִנְּעֻרַ֖י עַד־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ham·me·leḵ miṯ·hal·lêḵ lip̄·nê·ḵem wa·’ă·nî zā·qan·tî wā·śaḇ·tî ū·ḇā·nay hin·nām ’it·tə·ḵem wa·’ă·nî hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî lip̄·nê·ḵem min·nə·‘u·ray ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now here is the king walking before you and I am old and gray and my sons are here with you I have walked before you from my youth until this day
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, eis que o rei vai adiante de vós. Eu já envelheci e encaneci, e eis que meus filhos estão convosco, e tenho andado diante de vós desde a minha mocidade até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י עֲנ֣וּ בִי֩ נֶ֨גֶד יְהוָ֜ה וְנֶ֣גֶד מְשִׁיח֗וֹ אֶת־ שׁוֹר֩׀ מִ֨י לָקַ֜חְתִּי וַחֲמ֧וֹר מִ֣י לָקַ֗חְתִּי וְאֶת־ מִ֤י עָשַׁ֙קְתִּי֙ אֶת־ מִ֣י רַצּ֔וֹתִי וּמִיַּד־ מִי֙ לָקַ֣חְתִּי כֹ֔פֶר וְאַעְלִ֥ים עֵינַ֖י בּ֑וֹ וְאָשִׁ֖יב לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ‘ă·nū ḇî ne·ḡeḏ Yah·weh wə·ne·ḡeḏ mə·šî·ḥōw ’eṯ- šō·wr mî lā·qaḥ·tî wa·ḥă·mō·wr mî lā·qaḥ·tî wə·’eṯ- mî ‘ā·šaq·tî ’eṯ- mî raṣ·ṣō·w·ṯî ū·mî·yaḏ- mî lā·qaḥ·tî ḵō·p̄er wə·’a‘·lîm ‘ê·nay bōw wə·’ā·šîḇ lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Here I am Bear witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed Whose ox or donkey have I taken Whom have I cheated - or oppressed From whose hand . . . have I accepted a bribe and closed my eyes Tell me, and I will restore it to you
verses.literalPt: Eis-me aqui; testificai contra mim perante o SENHOR, e perante o seu ungido, a quem o boi tomei, a quem o jumento tomei, e a quem defraudei, a quem tenho oprimido, e de cuja mão tenho recebido suborno e com ele encobri os meus olhos, e vo-lo restituirei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֲשַׁקְתָּ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א רַצּוֹתָ֑נוּ וְלֹֽא־ לָקַ֥חְתָּ מִיַּד־ אִ֖ישׁ מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lō ‘ă·šaq·tā·nū wə·lō raṣ·ṣō·w·ṯā·nū wə·lō- lā·qaḥ·tā mî·yaḏ- ’îš mə·’ū·māh
verses.literal: You have not cheated us or oppressed us they replied nor have you taken anything from the hand of man
verses.literalPt: Então disseram: Em nada nos defraudaste, nem nos oprimiste, nem recebeste coisa alguma da mão de ninguém.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם עֵ֧ד יְהוָ֣ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעֵ֤ד מְשִׁיחוֹ֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֧א מְצָאתֶ֛ם בְּיָדִ֖י מְא֑וּמָה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר עֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ‘êḏ Yah·weh bā·ḵem wə·‘êḏ mə·šî·ḥōw hay·yō·wm haz·zeh kî lō mə·ṣā·ṯem bə·yā·ḏî mə·’ū·māh way·yō·mer ‘êḏ
verses.literal: Samuel said to them The LORD is a witness against you and His anointed is a witness today . . . that you have not found anything in my hand He is a witness they replied
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: O SENHOR seja testemunha contra vós, e o seu ungido seja hoje testemunha, que nada tendes achado na minha mão. E disse o povo: Ele é testemunha.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- hā·‘ām Yah·weh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wa·’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lāh ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to the people The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel ao povo: O SENHOR é o que escolheu a Moisés e a Arão, e tirou a vossos pais da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ צִדְק֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū wə·’iš·šā·p̄ə·ṭāh ’it·tə·ḵem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’êṯ kāl- ṣiḏ·qō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ’it·tə·ḵem wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Now present yourselves so that I may confront you before the LORD with all the righteous acts He has done for you and your fathers
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ponde-vos aqui em pé, e pleitearei convosco perante o SENHOR, sobre todos os atos de justiça do SENHOR, que fez a vós e a vossos pais.

verses.original: כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיּוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֶת־ אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּשִׁב֖וּם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer- bā ya·‘ă·qōḇ miṣ·rā·yim way·yiz·‘ă·qū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’el- Yah·weh way·yiš·laḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem mim·miṣ·ra·yim way·yō·ši·ḇūm bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: When Jacob went to Egypt your fathers cried out to the LORD and He sent them Moses and Aaron who brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place
verses.literalPt: Havendo entrado Jacó no Egito, vossos pais clamaram ao SENHOR, e o SENHOR enviou a Moisés e a Arão que tiraram a vossos pais do Egito, e os fizeram habitar neste lugar.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּמְכֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֡ם בְּיַ֣ד סִֽיסְרָא֩ שַׂר־ צְבָ֨א חָצ֜וֹר וּבְיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וּבְיַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kə·ḥū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem way·yim·kōr ’ō·ṯām bə·yaḏ sî·sə·rā śar- ṣə·ḇā ḥā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ū·ḇə·yaḏ me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū bām
verses.literal: But they forgot the LORD their God and He sold them into the hand of Sisera the commander of the army of Hazor and into the hands of the Philistines . . . and the king of Moab who fought against them
verses.literalPt: Porém esqueceram-se do SENHOR seu Deus; então os vendeu à mão de Sísera, capitão do exército de Hazor, e na mão dos filisteus, e na mão do rei dos moabitas, que pelejaram contra eles.

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָ֔אנוּ כִּ֤י עָזַ֙בְנוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וַנַּעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְעַתָּ֗ה הַצִּילֵ֛נוּ מִיַּ֥ד אֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mɛr ḥā·ṭā·nū kî ‘ā·zaḇ·nū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wan·na·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hā·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ wə·‘at·tāh haṣ·ṣî·lê·nū mî·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·nū wə·na·‘aḇ·ḏe·kā
verses.literal: Then they cried out to the LORD and said We have sinned for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies that we may serve You
verses.literalPt: E clamaram ao SENHOR, e disseram: Pecamos, pois deixamos ao SENHOR, e servimos aos baalins e astarotes; agora, pois, livra-nos da mão de nossos inimigos, e te serviremos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יְרֻבַּ֣עַל וְאֶת־ בְּדָ֔ן וְאֶת־ יִפְתָּ֖ח וְאֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיַּצֵּ֨ל אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִיַּ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵיכֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בֶּֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·rub·ba·‘al wə·’eṯ- bə·ḏān wə·’eṯ- yip̄·tāḥ wə·’eṯ- šə·mū·’êl way·yaṣ·ṣêl ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem mis·sā·ḇîḇ wat·tê·šə·ḇū be·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal Barak Jephthah and Samuel and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side and you dwelt securely
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR enviou a Jerubaal, e a Baraque, e a Jefté, e a Samuel; e livrou-vos da mão de vossos inimigos em redor, e habitastes seguros.

verses.original: וַתִּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי־ נָחָ֞שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּוֹן֮ בָּ֣א עֲלֵיכֶם֒ וַתֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔י לֹ֕א כִּי־ מֶ֖לֶךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tir·’ū kî- nā·ḥāš me·leḵ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn bā ‘ă·lê·ḵem wat·tō·mə·rū lî lō kî- me·leḵ yim·lōḵ ‘ā·lê·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem mal·kə·ḵem
verses.literal: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites . . . was moving against you you said to me No . . . we must have a king to rule over us even though the LORD your God was your king
verses.literalPt: E vendo vós que Naás, rei dos filhos de Amom, vinha contra vós, me dissestes: Não, mas reinará sobre nós um rei; sendo, porém, o SENHOR vosso Deus, o vosso rei.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁאֶלְתֶּ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer bə·ḥar·tem ’ă·šer šə·’el·tem wə·hin·nêh nā·ṯan Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem me·leḵ
verses.literal: Now here is the king you have chosen the one you requested Behold the LORD has placed a king over you
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, vedes aí o rei que elegestes e que pedistes; e eis que o SENHOR tem posto sobre vós um rei.

verses.original: אִם־ תִּֽירְא֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּקֹל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תַמְר֖וּ אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וִהְיִתֶ֣ם גַּם־ אַתֶּ֗ם וְגַם־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַחַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tî·rə·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ō·ṯōw ū·šə·ma‘·tem bə·qō·lōw wə·lō ṯam·rū ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh wih·yi·ṯem gam- ’at·tem wə·ḡam- ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer mā·laḵ ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’a·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice and if you do not rebel against the command of the LORD and if both you and the king who rules over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well
verses.literalPt: Se temerdes ao SENHOR, e o servirdes, e derdes ouvidos à sua voz, e não fordes rebeldes ao mandado do SENHOR, assim vós, como o rei que reina sobre vós, seguireis o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וּמְרִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֧ה יַד־ יְהוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ū·mə·rî·ṯem ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh yaḏ- Yah·weh bā·ḵem ū·ḇa·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: But if you disobey . . . . . . the LORD and rebel against His command then the hand of the LORD will be against you as it was against your fathers
verses.literalPt: Mas se não derdes ouvidos à voz do SENHOR, e antes fordes rebeldes ao mandado do SENHOR, a mão do SENHOR será contra vós, como o era contra vossos pais.

verses.original: גַּם־ עַתָּה֙ הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ וּרְא֔וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ‘at·tāh hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū ū·rə·’ū ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār hag·gā·ḏō·wl haz·zeh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Now therefore present yourselves and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes
verses.literalPt: Ponde-vos também agora aqui, e vede esta grande coisa que o SENHOR vai fazer diante dos vossos olhos.

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא קְצִיר־ חִטִּים֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶקְרָא֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְיִתֵּ֥ן קֹל֖וֹת וּמָטָ֑ר וּדְע֣וּ וּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי־ רָעַתְכֶ֤ם רַבָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לִשְׁא֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w qə·ṣîr- ḥiṭ·ṭîm hay·yō·wm ’eq·rā ’el- Yah·weh wə·yit·tên qō·lō·wṯ ū·mā·ṭār ū·ḏə·‘ū ū·rə·’ū kî- rā·‘aṯ·ḵem rab·bāh ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh liš·’ō·wl lā·ḵem me·leḵ
verses.literal: Is it not the wheat harvest today I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain so that you will know and see . . . what a great evil you have committed in the sight of the LORD by asking for a king
verses.literalPt: Não é hoje a sega do trigo? Clamarei, pois, ao SENHOR, e dará trovões e chuva; e sabereis e vereis que é grande a vossa maldade, que tendes feito perante o SENHOR, pedindo para vós um rei.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה קֹלֹ֥ת וּמָטָ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּירָ֨א כָל־ הָעָ֥ם מְאֹ֛ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā šə·mū·’êl ’el- Yah·weh way·yit·tên Yah·weh qō·lōṯ ū·mā·ṭār bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yî·rā ḵāl hā·‘ām mə·’ōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- šə·mū·’êl
verses.literal: So Samuel called to the LORD and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel
verses.literalPt: Então invocou Samuel ao SENHOR, e o SENHOR deu trovões e chuva naquele dia; por isso todo o povo temeu sobremaneira ao SENHOR e a Samuel.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֜ם אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הִתְפַּלֵּ֧ל בְּעַד־ עֲבָדֶ֛יךָ אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וְאַל־ נָמ֑וּת כִּֽי־ יָסַ֤פְנוּ עַל־ כָּל־ חַטֹּאתֵ֙ינוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה לִשְׁאֹ֥ל לָ֖נוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ḵāl hā·‘ām ’el- šə·mū·’êl hiṯ·pal·lêl bə·‘aḏ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·’al- nā·mūṯ kî- yā·sap̄·nū ‘al- kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·nū rā·‘āh liš·’ōl lā·nū me·leḵ
verses.literal: They . . . pleaded with Samuel Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king
verses.literalPt: E todo o povo disse a Samuel: Roga pelos teus servos ao SENHOR teu Deus, para que não venhamos a morrer; porque a todos os nossos pecados temos acrescentado este mal, de pedirmos para nós um rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ הָעָם֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔אוּ אַתֶּ֣ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אַ֗ךְ אַל־ תָּס֙וּרוּ֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- hā·‘ām ’al- tî·rā·’ū ’at·tem ‘ă·śî·ṯem ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ ’aḵ ’al- tā·sū·rū mê·’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’eṯ- Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: Do not be afraid Samuel . . . . . . replied Even though you have committed all this . . . evil do not turn aside from following the LORD but serve the LORD with all your heart
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel ao povo: Não temais; vós tendes cometido todo este mal; porém não vos desvieis de seguir ao SENHOR, mas servi ao SENHOR com todo o vosso coração.

verses.original: וְלֹ֖א תָּס֑וּרוּ כִּ֣י׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַתֹּ֗הוּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יוֹעִ֛ילוּ וְלֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ כִּי־ תֹ֥הוּ הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō tā·sū·rū kî ’a·ḥă·rê hat·tō·hū ’ă·šer lō- yō·w·‘î·lū wə·lō yaṣ·ṣî·lū kî- ṯō·hū hêm·māh
verses.literal: Do not turn aside . . . after worthless things that cannot profit you . . . or deliver you for they are empty
verses.literalPt: E não vos desvieis; pois seguiríeis as vaidades, que nada aproveitam, e tampouco vos livrarão, porque vaidades são.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יִטֹּ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר שְׁמ֣וֹ הַגָּד֑וֹל כִּ֚י הוֹאִ֣יל יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֶתְכֶ֛ם ל֖וֹ לְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- yiṭ·ṭōš Yah·weh ’eṯ- ‘am·mōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr šə·mōw hag·gā·ḏō·wl kî hō·w·’îl Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ·ḵem lōw lə·‘ām
verses.literal: Indeed for the sake of His great name the LORD will not abandon His people because He was pleased to make you His own
verses.literalPt: Pois o SENHOR, por causa do seu grande nome, não desamparará o seu povo; porque aprouve ao SENHOR fazer-vos o seu povo.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י חָלִ֤ילָה לִּי֙ מֵחֲטֹ֣א לַֽיהוָ֔ה מֵחֲדֹ֖ל לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעַדְכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה וְהַיְשָׁרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥā·lî·lāh lî mê·ḥă·ṭō Yah·weh mê·ḥă·ḏōl lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl ba·‘aḏ·ḵem wə·hō·w·rê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·ḏe·reḵ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh wə·hay·šā·rāh
verses.literal: As for me far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you And I will continue to teach you the good and right way
verses.literalPt: E quanto a mim, longe de mim que eu peque contra o SENHOR, deixando de orar por vós; antes vos ensinarei o caminho bom e direito.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ יְר֣אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֛וֹ בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י רְא֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ הִגְדִּ֖ל עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ yə·r·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ō·ṯōw be·’ĕ·meṯ bə·ḵāl lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem kî rə·’ū ’êṯ ’ă·šer- hiḡ·dil ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: Above all fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart . . . consider what great things He has done for you
verses.literalPt: Tão-somente temei ao SENHOR, e servi-o fielmente com todo o vosso coração; porque vede quão grandiosas coisas vos fez.

verses.original: וְאִם־ הָרֵ֖עַ תָּרֵ֑עוּ גַּם־ אַתֶּ֥ם גַּֽם־ מַלְכְּכֶ֖ם תִּסָּפֽוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hā·rê·a‘ tā·rê·‘ū gam- ’at·tem gam- mal·kə·ḵem tis·sā·p̄ū
verses.literal: But if you persist in doing evil . . . both you and your king will be swept away
verses.literalPt: Porém, se perseverardes em fazer mal, perecereis, assim vós como o vosso rei.
